## Usage

```text
provenance verify content [flags]
```

Compute the whole-repository design history file content hash at HEAD or at a given commit. The value is suffixed -dirty if the working tree differs from HEAD.

With `--expected`, compare against a known value and exit 1 on mismatch instead of only printing it.

Exit codes: 0 printed or matched, 1 mismatch against `--expected`, 2 tool or usage error.

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--commit hash` | — | compute the hash at this commit hash (default: HEAD) |
| `--expected hash` | — | expected content hash; exit 1 if it differs |
